build_package_protos: build Python and gRPC stubs from all .proto files in a given package root directory
build_package_protos_strict: build Python and gRPC stubs from proto files and raise an exception on any compilation failure
BuildPackageProtos_run: run the setuptools custom command to generate protobuf modules from proto files in the distribution package directory
BuildPackageProtos_strict_mode: run the setuptools BuildPackageProtos command with strict mode enabled to fail on proto compilation errors
BuildPackageProtos_initialize_options: initialize the BuildPackageProtos setuptools command options with strict mode set to false by default
